## Goals

-   Use skills developed over the semester to analyze the ice-off data in more detail
-   Construct a dashboard that displays the data and analysis

## What is a dashboard?

-   A dashboard is a website or document that uses graphs, tables, and other visual elements to represent data and analyses.
-   A dashboard has an audience and should support decision-making

## Principles of building a dashboard {.smaller}

-   Keep it Simple and Intuitive 
-   Use Consistent Design Elements 
-   Prioritize Information
-   Make it Responsive
-   Use White Space Effectively
-   Use Consistent Layout
-   Design for Speed
-   Keep the Dashboard Updated
-   Maintain Data Accuracy and Source Reliability

::: aside
[Dashboard design principles](https://medium.com/@mokkup/8-essential-dashboard-design-principles-for-effective-data-visualization-40653c5fd135)
:::

## Dashboards in Quarto

-   Quarto has an output type called a dashboard
-   Built around the concept of "cards" in columns and rows
-   Able to be easily deployed to a website
-   Same approach as the Quarto documents we have used

## Dashboards in Quarto

```         
---
title: "Sunapee Ice-off Dashboard"
format: 
  dashboard:
    embed-resources: true
---

## Row {height="20%"}

ADD CHUNK (CARD)

### Column 

ADD CHUNK (CARD)

### Column
```

## Science question

-   How is lake ice across the globe changing over time?

-   `assignment/assignment.md` describes the full requirements
